datasets.name: Smartphone Photography Attribute and Quality Database
datasets.access: Official repository lists Google Drive and Baidu releases. Manual download.

license.expression: Package Readme permits educational and research use; commercial software or hardware use requires author permission.

datasets.notes: Join images to MOS and the five attribute columns by Image name. Do not treat MOS as aesthetic beauty.

datasets.name: KonIQ-10k

license.expression: Portal terms require review; treat as research-community data until a commercial grant is confirmed.

datasets.notes: The 1024x768 ZIP contains 10,373 JPEGs; the score CSV has 10,073 unique image_name values. Always inner-join on the CSV and drop the 300 unlabeled files.

datasets.name: KonIQ++
datasets.access: CSV is a direct download; images are the KonIQ-10k set.

license.expression: Same research-community terms as KonIQ-10k images; CSV from MMSP Konstanz portal.

datasets.notes: Join filename to KonIQ-10k JPEGs. Do not invent a separate image tree.

datasets.name: CID2013 Camera Image Database

license.expression: Zenodo record; follow CID2013 copyright notice in the package and paper.

datasets.notes: Use CID2013 MOS sheet Source_ID joined to JPEG stems. Prefer realigned MOS when comparing across image sets.

datasets.name: UHD-IQA Benchmark Database
datasets.access: Direct ZIP from MMSP Konstanz. Images CC0 (Pixabay pre-2019).

license.expression: Images CC0; ratings provided for the research community.

datasets.notes: Official training/validation/test columns are source provenance, not an Image-JEV freeze. Do not copy onto D: unless free space exceeds the unpacked tree (~10 GiB).
